data_source: on-chain snapshot with forward-only PegTracker point history

peg.market_price_source: single source: Curve StableSwap-NG DUSD (Alto token 0x63d74d22E689C715a04F2C13962b1f77F443d35b) / frxUSD pool 0x104d6a1b97A6CEf88D905d7b865A378d90be932A get_dy, composed with tracked Chainlink frxUSD/USD; no second live Alto DUSD venue exists
peg.source: Curve get_dy DUSD/frxUSD swap rate multiplied by Chainlink frxUSD/USD
peg.nav_basis: FixedPriceStrategy mint/redeem reference is fixed at 1e18 against frxUSD; this is the declared reference, not a holder-accessible redemption quote
peg.premium_discount_basis: signed (market price - fixed $1 par) / fixed $1 par * 100
peg.history_coverage: forward-only from 2026-09-21; archive derivation withheld pending the required method handoff

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: deliberately underivable as one safety ratio: the 100% USM tranche has zero buffer, while CDP collateral is isolated and not generally claimable by DUSD holders; blending them would hide opposite failure modes

usm.ratio_basis: underlying token units divided by DUSD minted; exactly 1:1 to the wei
usm.access_mode: PERMISSIONED; sole SWAPPER_ROLE holder is treasury Safe 0xA1148A1b94262540994Cf9Aa431A13ad39764228
usm.is_seized_basis: solvency-critical: seize() transfers the entire underlying balance to stableTokenTreasury while DUSD remains outstanding
usm.exposure_cap_basis: DUSD USM configured cap; token units

cdp.ratio_basis: USD collateral value from each market's own Alto oracle divided by isolated market DUSD debt; collateral is liquidatable and not a general DUSD-holder claim

markets.collateral: 8 dust markets: WETH, wstETH, rETH, mETH, tBTC, sUSDe, syrupUSDC, frxUSD
markets.oracle: each market's own Alto oracle; grouped because individual values are immaterial

backing.total_supply_scope: Ethereum DUSD token 0x63d74d22E689C715a04F2C13962b1f77F443d35b totalSupply only; no bridge deployment is enumerated and no OFT peer has been set
backing.breakdown_basis: minted-side partition; collateral values are intentionally not used as an allocation because they do not partition supply
backing.arithmetic_only_blended_ratio_basis: informational arithmetic only; never a safety margin

asset_specific.snapshot_basis: Backing quantities re-confirmed at Ethereum block 26020013; peg point observed separately at 2026-09-21T07:15:32.304510Z.
